description: Your Pokémon card collection's value in the bar; click to open Toploader.

barWidget.description: Poké Ball with your collection's value. Click to open Toploader, middle-click to refresh.

schema.label: Show collection value

schema.label: Refresh (minutes)
schema.description: How often the value is re-read from your collection. It uses saved prices only, so this is cheap and offline.
